newsitem.title: POLAND: WARSAW BOURSE AWAITS DAMAGE ESTIMATES FROM 4 FIRMS.
newsitem.headline: WARSAW BOURSE AWAITS DAMAGE ESTIMATES FROM 4 FIRMS.

text.p: The Warsaw Stock Exchange will resume trade in four stocks suspended due to heavy flooding in southern Poland following a release of flood-damage estimates by the affected companies, a bourse deputy president said.
"The companies will resume trade once they submit official statements on the scope of losses suffered during the flooding," Ryszard Czerniawski told Reuters on Monday.
A total of seven stocks have suffered temporary trade suspensions due to the flooding and Polifarb Wroclaw, ZEW , Rafako and Viscoplast remain suspended.
On Monday Rafako said it would be able to resume production in September and Viscoplast said it was still not able to resume output, but gave no further details.
ZEW last week announced it would release damage estimates and financial results for the first half on August 6.
